scope: The disk reconstruction in Proposition nonclosed-reduction, not the entire integral-density theorem.
universal_domain: Arbitrary ranks of the named finite free modules over any commutative ring; zero blocks are allowed. The manuscript application uses its full ring of integers.
source_fragments: On return, the starting interval still has just one lift

generic_lower_data.meaning: PA and PB identify h_U with h_A and h_B; IA identifies h_A with h_Q. The fourth contact is forced by the -I disk, while all four off-diagonal shears remain arbitrary.
generic_lower_data.normalization: Block diagonal on A direct_sum B; identity on the named a,b,x,y quotients; invertible on every h contact.
generic_lower_data.verification: Noncommutative polynomial identities with only adjacent inverse cancellation, valid in arbitrary block ranks.

split_stabilizer.quantifier: For every s >= 0 and all 1 <= k,j <= s

jacobian.interpretation: A bounded coefficient calculation for the universal h-block contraction, not a proof from sampled ranks.

not_formalized: Normalization of arbitrary lower-diagram data with their identified quotients
The geometric incidence and orientation interpretation
The locally affine bundle and integral-density conclusions

adversarial_controls: Changing the negative h coefficient to positive fails IP=0 over the integers.
Using U_i instead of U_(i-1) admits forbidden diagonal quotient shears.
Separate one-sided surjectivity does not imply two-sided surjectivity.
The universal split support formula is checked symbolically, not by a maximum tested rank.
